meta.provenance: [SIMULATION; endpoints resampled from rig windows, 1 bearing/fault, curve shape assumed]
meta.limits: No real run-to-failure data exists for 4 of 5 fault classes. Anchors = 5 physical bearings (H-01 + one per fault); test units are held-out simulated trajectories, not held-out bearings; the damage-curve family is assumed.
meta.phase: PRE-REGISTRATION: frozen choices written before the FRESH test units (rig_anchor_test2) are scored
meta.fresh_test_registered_in: splits.json section rig_anchor_test2 (commit 48c6643, before any v6 fit)

baseline_control.feature: mean of the last 6 rows of the health index hi (aggregate 'mean6:hi')

selection_rule.classifier: max val macro-F1 among configs with val false-alarm <= 0.03, tie -> more windows caught by stage 3 -> fewer trees
selection_rule.rul: min val S7 MAPE (unfiltered, no scale; min over alpha in {1.0, 0.5})
selection_rule.stage: min val (max stage error, #windows error>=2, -within1, MAE)
selection_rule.rul_post: min val S7 MAPE over alpha x scale_early x scale_late
selection_rule.baseline: OLS fit on train; alpha by val S7

oracle_floor_val.definition: privileged oracle: deployed-head regressor + hidden generator parameters (a, p, late_scale, anchor_u, life); noisy features only; NOT deployable
